_about: cc-P662: the Wakening Isle's look (build_isle.py reads it; nothing about the look is in the code). One seed per stage: a stage's random stream is Random(seed ^ crc32(stage name)), so switching a stage off or adding one never moves the others (playbook section 5). Every id below was measured on stock Trammel by the survey scripts beside this file, or picked from candidates.py's sheets. Coordinates are P481 section 11.2's (void C); the driver adds the site shift.

land._transitions: corner patterns top, right, bottom, left (survey_corners.py, survey_pairs.py); dirt aaba (grass at the bottom) is 0x0079, too rare on OSI's map for the survey (under 5 tiles) and confirmed by render beside 0x007A-0x007C (each grass patch at its measured corner); the diagonal saddles have no stock tile: the road grows over them, or the tile becomes grass
land._z: cc-P725: the first sand ring at -4, just above the sea, under OSI's surf pieces (shore-rule.json; it was -7 under P662's plain water diamond). P662: the sea at -5 as OSI's; the first sand ring at -7 under OSI's static water (shoreWater), so the water plane cuts the beach's slope into a smooth waterline as on OSI's coasts (osi-beach.png); then -3, -1 and 0; the road, meadow, yards and buildings at 0; the knoll to 8

corners._rule: playbook 2.2 for item-walled rooms: every inner corner gets at least one thing; passable pieces on the corner floor tile; wall torches only on a north or west wall at floor + 13; impassable pieces only on the visible strip (the south and east ring tiles, inside the wall's slab)

OSI's docks (survey: 1,325 planks over the sea at Z -3; the Trammel dock at 496,768): planks 0x07C9 and 0x07CD; rope rails 0x03A6 along x and 0x03A9 along y at deck + 5; corner posts stacked 0x03AE at deck - 5, 0x03A5 at deck, 0x03AB at deck + 5

stones._picked: candidates.py stones.png: the tall boulders read as standing stones, P481's rock 0x1772 as pebbles

decor._rule: seeded clusters with gaps, never two identical pieces side by side (scatter.pick_unlike); zone densities in pieces per 100 tiles, a tree counting as its two pieces; the woods must land inside 5 to 12

woods._cc-P725: superseded by tropics; kept for the record

shoreWater._measured: OSI lays the static water 0x1797 (Background, Impassable, Wet) on the first ring of sand (1,736 on sand within 2 of the sea, Trammel mainland), at the sea's Z: the flat water plane over the sloping sand draws the waterline

shoreFront._measured: cc-P725 (notes/cc-P725-tools/surf-survey.json, stock Trammel mainland, neighbours N NE E SE S SW W NW): 0x179D (857 of 1,032) and 0x179E (885 of 1,056) with land only NE, E, SE; 0x17A1 (814 of 960) and 0x17A2 (810 of 942) with land only SE, S, SW; 0x17A7 (1,455 of 1,581) with land NE to SW. Each covers the tile's far part, so the shore land under it shows the near part. Land: impassable sand 0x001A, so the half-water tile is not walked.

tropics._rule: cc-P725 (Chase 10-28 11:50: palms, banana and jungle trees, ferns, tropical shrubs, flowers and grasses; denser inland, thinning toward the beaches; clusters, not a grid). Every id is stock art OSI plants on Buccaneer's Den's island (notes/cc-P725-tools/tropics-bucs.txt counts them: ferns 0x0C9F-0x0CA4 2,704, small palms 0x0C99-0x0C9D 929, the jungle trees 0x0D41-0x0D93, fan plant 136, o'hii 125, elephant ear 109, blade plant 107, pampas 88). Tiers by Chebyshev distance from the sand: beach (sand at least beachFromSea from the sea), edge (to edgeTo), middle (to middleTo), deep. A tile's chance is the tier's share times a field of round clumps (one per tilesPerClump land tiles, radius clumpRadius). Trees stay treeClear tiles from the road, every stop and server item, and the buildings, yard, square and meadow; nothing grows within wakeClearPlants of the wake-up spot, and no tree within wakeClearTrees.
